Class LoyaltyService

java.lang.Object
am.gortsup.testing.service.LoyaltyService
public class LoyaltyService extends Object
Service managing customer loyalty rewards, points accumulation, tier levels, and point transfers.

  • Method Details

    • addPoints

      public void addPoints(String userId, int pointsEarned)
      Awards loyalty reward points to a customer. Updates both current spendable balance and lifetime points.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      pointsEarned - positive points to add (> 0)
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if userId is empty or pointsEarned invalid input: '<'= 0

    • redeemPoints

      public void redeemPoints(String userId, int pointsToRedeem)
      Spends/redeems points from the customer's available balance. Lifetime points are not decreased by redemption.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      pointsToRedeem - points to spend (> 0)
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if pointsToRedeem invalid input: '<'= 0 or exceeds available balance

    • getPoints

      public int getPoints(String userId)
      Returns current spendable points for a customer.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      Returns:
      points balance (0 if none)

    • getLifetimePoints

      public int getLifetimePoints(String userId)
      Returns total accumulated lifetime points for tier qualification.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      Returns:
      lifetime points (0 if none)

    • calculateTier

      public LoyaltyTier calculateTier(int totalLifetimePoints)
      Determines loyalty tier based on cumulative lifetime points. Tiers: - 0 to 999: BRONZE - 1000 to 4999: SILVER - 5000 to 9999: GOLD - 10000 and above: PLATINUM
      Parameters:
      totalLifetimePoints - lifetime points (must be >= 0)
      Returns:
      LoyaltyTier
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if points invalid input: '<' 0

    • getUserTier

      public LoyaltyTier getUserTier(String userId)
      Retrieves the current loyalty tier for a user.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      Returns:
      current tier

    • getTierDiscountPercentage

      public double getTierDiscountPercentage(LoyaltyTier tier)
      Returns exclusive percentage discount associated with a loyalty tier: - BRONZE: 0.0% - SILVER: 5.0% - GOLD: 10.0% - PLATINUM: 15.0%
      Parameters:
      tier - loyalty tier
      Returns:
      discount percentage

    • transferPoints

      public void transferPoints(String fromUserId, String toUserId, int points)
      Transfers points from one user to another.
      Parameters:
      fromUserId - source user ID
      toUserId - recipient user ID
      points - points to transfer (> 0)
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if arguments are invalid, users are identical, or insufficient balance
